text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото loses against T.M. Opera
O. Air
Shakur believes this is just one of
many future
consecutive losses.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It appears that Мэйсё Дото has yet to
exceed
Opera O's capabilities, let alone
the previous
generation's. The reason
behind her stagnant rate
of growth is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Her reverence for Т.М. Опера О. She respects her idol too much, and it's causing her to hold back against her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't start seeing her idol as a
rival, the
future will remain bleak. She
needs to realize this
before our next
race, the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
